caseName: United States ex rel. Eichenlaub v. Shaughnessy
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Eichenlaub v. Shaughnessy, Acting District Director of Immigration and Naturalization

opinions.text:
The motion to withdraw the appearance of Charles Edwin Wallington as counsel for the petitioner is granted.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
